tree.specfit_adaptive_depth: after drafting level d < 5 (or the tail limit), stop when SpecFit on the depth<=d pool selects no depth-d node; its selection is final

limitations: EAGLE-3 via speculators and project offload backend, not official default tree parameters.
SpecFit offline route acquisition excluded; not online end-to-end performance.
Same-query repeat verified; cross-tree and AR output equality not assumed.
Adaptive SpecFit uses the packed exact search at every drafted level, with routes of the depth<=d prefix taken from its separate reference that probes the full 18-node pool.
One adaptive SpecFit stream on GPU 0 over 40 of the 80 GSM8K questions (even question IDs); exact routes, EAGLE and AR come from the sealed full-length streams on this GPU.

Simulated predictor: each routed expert of every node and layer is kept with probability 0.8, otherwise replaced by a uniformly drawn expert outside its true top-8; real predictor errors are not uniform.
